description: This file handles the saving process for EmailTemplate records in SuiteCRM. It initializes a new EmailTemplate bean, populates it from POST data, and invokes save methods. It also manages the user interface behavior for both popup and non-popup contexts, including refreshing templates in the parent window if needed.

classes.name: EmailTemplateFormBase
classes.description: A class responsible for managing email template forms, including handling save actions and possibly validation.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Method in EmailTemplateFormBase that processes the save operation for an email template, with parameters controlling save behavior and redirection.
